name: James Tagg
abstract_title: Orch-OR and the origin of life. Computation in an Orch-OR world.
abstract: We propose a new framework wherein quantum self-replication drives gravitational collapse in prebiotic molecular systems, serving as a natural quantum search mechanism. Inspired by Grover’s algorithm, but grounded in Penrose-Hameroff Orch-OR theory, our model suggests that the amplification of mass-energy through self-replication within a quantum superposition triggers objective reduction. This process selects self-replicating configurations without the need for phase inversion or decoherence pr
